title: Controlling Bias Exposure for Fair Interpretable Predictions

bias_targets.methodology: Reporting the F1 score for gender prediction using a pretrained classifier before and after debiasing on toxicity detection and profession classification tasks, and calculating the root-mean-square difference in True Positive Rates (RMS TPR-GAP) between gender groups.
Measuring the accuracy gap of a pretrained race classifier before and after applying the debiasing algorithm on open-ended text generation outputs prompted from the BOLD dataset.
